data.name: Ekambari
data.long_meaning: Ekambari is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Ekam' which means 'Oneness'. In Hindu mythology, Ekambari is the Goddess of Oneness, representing the idea of unity and wholeness. She is often depicted carrying a pot of rice or grain on her head, symbolizing abundance and nourishment.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the unity of all things in the universe.
